Boxplots showing the distribution of Ka/Ks ratios across different gene duplication types
```{r}
output_dir <- here("products", "plots")
file_name <- "Ka_Ks_boxplot_valid.png"
full_path <- file.path(output_dir, file_name)

df_pairs <- dup_list_valid[["zma"]]$pairs

my_colors <- c("DD" = "#9ecae1",
               "SD" = "#a1d99b",
               "dTRD" = "#fdbb84",
               "PD" = "#bcbddc",
               "rTRD" = "#d77fb3",
               "TD" = "#9e9ac8")

median_data <- df_pairs %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(median_val = median(Ka_Ks, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(median_txt = sprintf("%.4f", median_val))

p <- ggplot(df_pairs, aes(x = type, y = Ka_Ks, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 6)) +

  theme_classic() +
  
  labs(title = "Ka/Ks Distribution by Type",
       x = "Duplication Type",
       y = "Ka/Ks Ratio") +
  
  theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
      
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)
    )

ggsave(filename = full_path, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# 2.2 Expression levels of duplicated genes

```{r}
# Define color palette for duplication modes
dup_pal <- c(
    SD = "#000000",  
    TD = "#E69F00",
    PD = "#56B4E9",
    rTRD = "#009E73",
    dTRD = "#F0E442",
    DD = "#0072B2"
)
```


```{r}
dup_genes <- dup_list_valid[["zma"]]$genes
# dup_genes: 28902 x 2 (gene, type)

# sum
expr_sum <- rowSums(logcounts(zma_spe_valid), na.rm = TRUE)

expr_sum_df <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = names(expr_sum),
  exp  = as.numeric(expr_sum)
)

sum_df <- expr_sum_df |>
  dplyr::inner_join(dup_genes, by = "gene") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species   = "zma",
    statistic = "sum",
    type      = factor(type, levels = names(dup_pal))
  )

nrow(sum_df)
head(sum_df)

# mean
expr_mean <- rowMeans(logcounts(zma_spe_valid), na.rm = TRUE)

expr_mean_df <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = names(expr_mean),
  exp  = as.numeric(expr_mean)
)

mean_df <- expr_mean_df |>
  dplyr::inner_join(dup_genes, by = "gene") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species   = "zma",
    statistic = "mean",
    type      = factor(type, levels = names(dup_pal))
  )

nrow(mean_df)
head(mean_df)
```
```{r}
# Combine all `SpatialExperiment` objects in a single list
sum_combined <- sum_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    csum    = exp,
    species = "Zma"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, type, species, csum) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Get mean of gene expression levels across all samples
mean_combined <- mean_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cmean   = exp,
    species = "Zma"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, type, species, cmean) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Compare distros and get CLDs
## Sum
sum_clds <- cld_kw_dunn(
  sum_combined,
  var   = "type",
  value = "csum"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = factor("Zma", levels = c("Zma")),
    x       = max(sum_combined$csum, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(type = Group)

#### Mean
mean_clds <- cld_kw_dunn(
  mean_combined,
  var   = "type",
  value = "cmean"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = factor("Zma", levels = c("Zma")),
    x       = max(mean_combined$cmean, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(type = Group)
```

```{r}
p_sum_combined <- ggplot(sum_combined, aes(x = csum, y = type)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = type), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dup_pal) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.color = "gray60", outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_label(
    data = sum_clds,
    aes(x = x, y = type, label = Letter)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(x = list(

  labs(
    x = "Sum of log-transformed normalized counts", y = NULL,
    title = "Total expression levels and gene duplication mode (Zma)",

  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = bg))

p_mean_combined <- ggplot(mean_combined, aes(x = cmean, y = type)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = type), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dup_pal) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.color = "gray60", outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_label(
    data = mean_clds, 
    aes(x = x, y = type, label = Letter)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(x = list(
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(mean_combined$cmean, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)
    )
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean of log-transformed normalized counts", y = NULL,
    title = "Mean expression level and gene duplication mode (Zma)",
    subtitle = "CLD from Kruskal-Wallis + post-hoc Dunn's test; P < 0.05"
  ) +
```

# 3.2 Expression breadths of duplicated genes
```{r}
#' Calculate the proportion of non-zero spots for each gene by cell type
#'
#' @param spe A SingleCellExperiment or SpatialExperiment object.
#' @param cell_type Character, name of the column with cell type information.
#'
#' @return A data frame with variables `gene`, `cell_type`, and `prop_detected`.
get_prop_detected <- function(spe,
                              cell_type  = "Celltype",
                                assay_name = "logcounts"
                                ) {
  
  mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(spe, assay_name)
  
  ct <- as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(spe)[[cell_type]])
  if (is.null(ct)) {
    stop("Column '", cell_type, "' not found in colData(spe).")
  }
  
  res_list <- lapply(unique(ct), function(cti) {
    idx  <- which(ct == cti)
    prop <- rowMeans(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE] != 0)
    
    tibble::tibble(
      gene          = rownames(mat),
      cell_type     = cti,
      prop_detected = as.numeric(prop)
    )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)
}

prop_detected_zma <- get_prop_detected(
  spe       = zma_spe_valid,
  cell_type = "Celltype"   # colData(zma_spe_valid)$Celltype
)

head(prop_detected_zma)

output_dir <- here("products", "results")
saveRDS(prop_detected_zma, file = file.path(output_dir, "prop_detected_zma.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Calculate absolute expression breadth
eb_zma <- prop_detected_zma |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene, cell_type) |>
  dplyr::mutate(mean_prop = mean(prop_detected, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(mean_prop >= 0.01) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene, cell_type, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "breadth") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(dup_list_valid[["zma"]]$genes, by = "gene") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = "Zma",
    type    = factor(type, levels = names(dup_pal))
  )

head(eb_zma)
```

```{r}
# Test for differences in expression breadth by duplication mode
eb_test <- cld_kw_dunn(
  eb_zma,
  var   = "type",
  value = "breadth"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = factor("Zma", levels = "Zma"),
    x = max(eb_zma$breadth, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(type = Group)
```

```{r}
# Plot distributions of absolute expression breadths
p_eb_zma <- ggplot(eb_zma, aes(x = breadth, y = type)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = type), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dup_pal) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.color = "gray60", outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_label(
    data = eb_test,
    aes(x = x, y = type, label = Letter)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Expression breadth (number of cell types)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Expression breadth and gene duplication mode (Zma)",
    subtitle = "CLD from Kruskal-Wallis + post-hoc Dunn's test; P < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = bg))

ggsave(
  file.path(here("products", "plots"), "Zma_expression_breadth.png"),
  plot   = p_eb_zma,
  width  = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi    = 300
)
```

# 3.3 Spatial variability of duplicated genes
```{r}
assayNames(zma_spe_valid)

assay(zma_spe_valid, "counts") <- assay(zma_spe_valid, "logcounts")

assayNames(zma_spe_valid)

```

```{r}
# Define helper function to identify SVGs with DESpace
get_svg <- function(spe, spatial_cluster = "Celltype") {
  
  res <- DESpace_test(
    spe              = spe,
    spatial_cluster  = spatial_cluster,
    replicates       = FALSE,
    min_counts       = 1,
    min_non_zero_spots = 5
  )
  gc()
  
  res_df <- res$gene_results |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR <= 0.05)
  
  return(res_df)
}

colData(zma_spe_valid)$Celltype   <- factor(colData(zma_spe_valid)$Celltype)
colData(zma_spe_valid)$Orig.ident <- factor(colData(zma_spe_valid)$Orig.ident)
colData(zma_spe_valid)$Condition  <- factor(colData(zma_spe_valid)$Condition)

res <- dsp_test(
  spe = zma_spe_valid,
  cluster_col = "Celltype",
  sample_col = "Orig.ident",
  condition_col = "Condition",
  test = "QLF",
  min_counts = 1,
  min_non_zero_spots = 5,
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Get svgs
get_svg <- function(spe, spatial_cluster = "Celltype", fdr_cutoff = 0.05) {

  res <- DESpace::svg_test(
    spe = spe,
    cluster_col = spatial_cluster,
    min_counts = 1,
    min_non_zero_spots = 5
  )

  res_df <- res$gene_results |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR <= fdr_cutoff)

  res_df
}

# Identify SVGs
svgs <- list(
  zma = get_svg(zma_spe_valid, spatial_cluster = "Celltype")
)


```

```{r}
# Define helper function to perform ORA for duplication modes
ora_dupmode <- function(svg_df, dup_df) {
  df <- HybridExpress::ora(
    genes       = svg_df$gene_id,
    annotation  = as.data.frame(dup_df),
    background  = dup_df$gene,
    min_setsize = 2,
    max_setsize = 1e8
  )
  return(df)
}

# Zma duplication annotation
dup_zma_genes <- dup_list_valid[["zma"]]$genes  # columns: gene, type

ora_svg_dup_zma <- lapply(
  svgs[["zma"]],
  ora_dupmode,
  dup_df = dup_zma_genes
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "sample") |>
  dplyr::mutate(species = "Zma") |>
  dplyr::select(
    species,
    sample,
    type = term,
    genes,
    all,
    padj
  )

head(ora_svg_dup_zma)
```
